scanNote: 9-mashqning 8-bandi yangi gap boshida turadi va undan keyin VERGUL qo'yilgan ('8) ......, she heard a strange noise'). Kitob bergan ro'yxatda faqat and, but, so, because, when bor ('then' YO'Q — bu 8-mashqning ro'yxatidan farq qiladi). Shu beshtadan gap boshida kela oladigan yagona so'z — 'but'. Vergulning 'But' dan keyin qo'yilishi rasmiy yozuvda g'ayrioddiy, lekin kitobda shunday bosilgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with words from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta predlog, 8 ta bo'shliq):
  over, along, up, towards, down, under, through, into

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

SAKKIZ RASM:
  1  O'g'ri derazadan ichkariga tirmashib kiryapti.
  2  Rolikli konkida ko'chada ketayotgan odam.
  3  To'p suzish havzasiga tushib ketyapti.
  4  Amerikacha futbolchi to'pni boshi tepasida ushlab turibdi.
  5  Ayol narvondan yuqoriga chiqyapti.
  6  Ot marra chizig'i tomon chopyapti.
  7  Oila yomg'irda soyabon ostida turibdi.
  8  Qiz tog'dan pastga chang'i uchyapti.

USUL — HARAKAT YO'NALIShIGA QARANG:
  ichkariga (teshik/deraza orqali) → through
  ichkariga (idish/havza)          → into
  yuqoriga                         → up
  pastga                           → down
  ustida/ustidan                   → over
  ostida                           → under
  uzunasiga                        → along
  ...tomon                         → towards

DIQQAT — 'THROUGH' va 'INTO' FARQI:
  THROUGH — TEShIK yoki OChIQ JOY orqali o'tib
     climb THROUGH the window (deraza orqali)
  INTO    — biror joyning IChIGA
     fall INTO the pool (havzaning ichiga)

items.textEn: 1  The thief is climbing ............ the window.
items.whyUz:
'climbing THROUGH the window' = derazadan tirmashib kiryapti.
THROUGH — ochiq joy (deraza) ORQALI o'tib.
DIQQAT: 'into the window' XATO —
'through the window INTO the house' bo'lardi.
'a thief' = o'g'ri;  ko'pligi: thieves.

items.textEn: 2  He is roller-skating ............ the street.
items.whyUz:
'roller-skating ALONG the street' = ko'cha bo'ylab
rolik uchyapti.
ALONG — UZUNASIGA harakat.
DIQQAT: 'across the street' bo'lsa ko'chani KESIB
o'tgan bo'lardi.
'to roller-skate' = rolikli konkida uchmoq.

items.textEn: 3  The ball fell ............ the swimming-pool.
items.whyUz:
'fell INTO the pool' = havzaga tushib ketdi.
INTO — IChKARIGA harakat.
fall → FELL (noto'g'ri fe'l).
Grammar 51-betda ham: 'threw the ball INTO the
swimming-pool'.

items.textEn: 4  He is holding the ball ............ his head.
items.whyUz:
'holding the ball OVER his head' = to'pni boshi ustida
ushlab turibdi.
OVER — USTIDA (tegmasdan).
DIQQAT: bu yerda 'over' HARAKAT emas, JOY bildiradi —
'over' ikkalasida ham ishlatiladi.
Aksi: under.

items.textEn: 5  The woman is climbing ............ the ladder.
items.whyUz:
'climbing UP the ladder' = narvondan yuqoriga chiqyapti.
UP — YUQORIGA.
Grammar 50-betda ham: 'The firefighter climbed UP the
ladder'.
Aksi: down (8-band).

items.textEn: 6  The horse is racing ............ the finish line.
items.whyUz:
'racing TOWARDS the finish line' = marra tomon chopyapti.
TOWARDS — YO'NALISh (hali yetib bormagan).
Grammar 50-betda ham: 'running TOWARDS the finishing line'.
'to race' = poyga qilmoq, chopmoq.

items.textEn: 7  They are standing ............ an umbrella.
items.whyUz:
'standing UNDER an umbrella' = soyabon ostida turishibdi.
UNDER — OSTIDA.
4-band bilan JUFT: over ↔ under.
DIQQAT: bu yerda ham JOY ma'nosida.

items.textEn: 8  The girl is skiing ............ the mountain.
items.whyUz:
'skiing DOWN the mountain' = tog'dan pastga chang'i uchyapti.
DOWN — PASTGA.
5-band bilan JUFT: up ↔ down.
'to ski' = chang'i uchmoq (Workbook 37-betda ham bor edi).

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple, present continuous or past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple, present continuous yoki past simple ga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI DIALOG — a) va b).

TO'LIQ DIALOGLAR (to'ldirilgan holda):

a)  A: Hi Jane. How ARE you?
    B: Oh fine, but I'M HAVING a really busy day. First I
       TOOK the dog to the vet. Then I WENT shopping and
       now I'M COOKING dinner for our dinner party tonight.
       I'm really exhausted.

b)  A: You ARE WEARING a lovely suit today Tim. Is it new?
    B: Yes it is actually. I BOUGHT it in Milan last week.
    A: Why DID YOU GO there?
    B: I HAD a business meeting.
    A: DID IT GO well?
    B: Yes, very well.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

a)  A: Salom Jeyn. Yaxshimisan?
    B: Yaxshi, lekin juda band kunim bo'lyapti. Avval itni
       veterinарga olib bordim. Keyin xaridga bordim va
       hozir bugungi ziyofatimiz uchun ovqat pishiryapman.
       Juda charchadim.

b)  A: Bugun ajoyib kostyum kiyibsan, Tim. Yangimi?
    B: Ha, rostdan ham. Uni o'tgan hafta Milanda sotib oldim.
    A: Nega u yerga borgan eding?
    B: Ish uchrashuvim bor edi.
    A: Yaxshi o'tdimi?
    B: Ha, juda yaxshi.


a) DIALOGDAGI VAQT ChIZIG'I — DIQQAT BILAN QARANG:
  'I'M HAVING a busy day'  → kun HALI DAVOM ETYAPTI
     → present continuous
  'First I TOOK ... Then I WENT'  → bugun ERTALAB bo'lgan,
     tugagan harakatlar → past simple
  'now I'M COOKING'  → AYNI DAMDA
     → present continuous

  Ya'ni bitta xatboshida UCH marta zamon almashadi —
  chunki kun davom etyapti, lekin ichidagi ba'zi
  harakatlar allaqachon tugagan.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a vet          = veterinar
  exhausted      = holdan toygan, juda charchagan
  a suit         = kostyum
  actually       = rostdan ham, aslida
  Milan          = Milan (Italiya shahri)
  a business meeting = ish uchrashuvi

items.textEn: a1  A: Hi Jane. How ............ (be) you?
items.whyUz:
'How ARE you?' = Yaxshimisan?
Standart salomlashish savoli.
'you' → ARE.

items.textEn: a2  B: Oh fine, but I ............ (have) a really busy day.
items.whyUz:
Kun HALI DAVOM ETYAPTI ('now I'm cooking' deb aytadi) →
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'I'M HAVING a busy day' = band kunim bo'lyapti.
DIQQAT: 'have' bu yerda BOShDAN KEChIRMOQ ma'nosida —
shuning uchun -ing OLADI.
('have' = ega bo'lmoq ma'nosida -ing olmaydi.)

items.textEn: a3  B: First I ............ (take) the dog to the vet.
items.whyUz:
'First' — bugun ERTALAB bo'lgan, TUGAGAN harakat →
PAST SIMPLE.
take → TOOK (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'a vet' = veterinar (veterinarian ning qisqasi).

items.textEn: a4  B: Then I ............ (go) shopping ...
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE. go → WENT.
'go shopping' — predlogsiz, -ing shakli bilan.
3-band bilan ketma-ket: First ... Then ...

items.textEn: a5  B: ... and now I ............ (cook) dinner for our dinner party tonight.
items.whyUz:
'NOW' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'I' → AM + cooking.
DIQQAT — BU XATBOShIDA UCh ZAMON:
  'm having (kun davom etyapti) → took, went (tugagan)
  → 'm cooking (ayni damda)
'exhausted' = holdan toygan.

items.textEn: b1  A: You ............ (wear) a lovely suit today Tim.
items.whyUz:
Hozir kiyib turibdi → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'You' → ARE + wearing.
'a suit' = kostyum.
DIQQAT: 'You wear a lovely suit' bo'lsa —
odat haqida bo'lardi, mos emas.

items.textEn: b2  B: Yes it is actually. I ............ (buy) it in Milan last week.
items.whyUz:
'last week' → PAST SIMPLE.
buy → BOUGHT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'actually' = rostdan ham, aslida.

items.textEn: b3  A: Why ............ (you/go) there?
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE SO'ROQ: DID + you + GO (asosiy shakl).
'did you went' XATO.
'there' = o'sha yerga (Milanga).

items.textEn: b4  B: I ............ (have) a business meeting.
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE. have → HAD.
DIQQAT: bu yerda 'have' = ega bo'lmoq ma'nosida
(uchrashuvim bor edi) — a2-band bilan solishtiring,
u yerda 'boshdan kechirmoq' ma'nosida edi.
'a business meeting' = ish uchrashuvi.

PAST SIMPLE SO'ROQ: DID + it + GO.
'go well' = yaxshi o'tmoq.
Javob: 'Yes, very well' — 'well' RAVISh.

exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI GAP BOShI va OLTI GAP DAVOMI.

Kitob BIRINI namuna qilib bergan:
  1 → a  (She didn't buy the vase BECAUSE she didn't have
          enough money.)

USUL — MANTIQIY BOG'LANIShNI TOPING:
  sovuq        → palto kiyish
  hammomda     → qo'ng'iroq jiringlashi
  idish yuvish → televizor ko'rish (ketma-ketlik)
  deraza yopish → parda yopish (ketma-ketlik)
  yordam so'rash → hech kim eshitmadi (ziddiyat)

pairs.right: a  She didn't have enough money.
pairs.whyUz:
KITOBDA BERILGAN.
SABAB: puli yetmagani uchun sotib olmadi.
'enough money' = yetarli pul.

pairs.right: d  Joe put his coat on.
pairs.whyUz:
SABAB → NATIJA: sovuq edi → palto kiydi.
'put on' = kiymoq;  put → PUT (o'zgarmaydi).

VAQT: hammomda edim — O'ShANDA qo'ng'iroq jiringladi.
Davom etayotgan holat + to'satdan bo'lgan voqea.
'a doorbell' = eshik qo'ng'irog'i;  ring → RANG.

KETMA-KETLIK: avval idish yuvdim, so'ng televizor ko'rdim.
'wash the dishes' = idish yuvmoq.

IKKI O'XShASh harakat ketma-ket → 'and' bilan bog'lanadi.
'to shut' = yopmoq (= to close);  shut → SHUT (o'zgarmaydi).
'curtains' = pardalar.

QARAMA-QARShILIK: qichqirdi ↔ lekin hech kim eshitmadi.
Coursebook 80-betda ham: 'there was no one there to
help him'.
'nobody' = hech kim.

exercises.instructionEn: Then join them using and, but, so, because, then or when.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng ularni and, but, so, because, then yoki when bilan birlashtiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI BOG'LOVChI, OLTI GAP —
har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  She didn't buy the vase BECAUSE she didn't have enough
  money.

USUL — MANTIQIY ALOQAGA QARANG:
  SABAB        → because
  NATIJA       → so
  VAQT         → when
  KETMA-KETLIK → then
  QO'ShIMChA   → and
  ZIDDIYAT     → but

DIQQAT — 'AND' va 'THEN' FARQI:
  AND  — ikki O'XShASh harakat (deraza + parda yopish)
  THEN — ANIQ ketma-ketlik (avval idish, keyin televizor)

items.textEn: 1  She didn't buy the vase. + She didn't have enough money.
items.answer: She didn't buy the vase because she didn't have enough money.
items.whyUz:
BECAUSE — SABAB.
Tartib: NATIJA (sotib olmadi) + because + SABAB (puli yo'q edi).

items.textEn: 2  It was very cold. + Joe put his coat on.
items.answer: It was very cold, so Joe put his coat on.
items.whyUz:
SO — NATIJA.
Tartib: SABAB (sovuq edi) + so + NATIJA (palto kiydi).
Oldidan VERGUL.

items.textEn: 3  I was in the bathroom. + The doorbell rang.
items.answer: I was in the bathroom when the doorbell rang.
items.whyUz:
WHEN — VAQT.
Davom etayotgan holat (hammomda edim) +
to'satdan bo'lgan voqea (qo'ng'iroq jiringladi).
Grammar 48-betdagi misolga o'xshash.

items.textEn: 4  I washed the dishes. + I watched TV.
items.answer: I washed the dishes, then I watched TV.
items.whyUz:
THEN — ANIQ ketma-ketlik: avval idish, keyin televizor.
Oldidan VERGUL.
Grammar 48-betda: 'She parked the car, THEN she went
inside.'

items.textEn: 5  I shut the window. + I closed the curtains.
items.answer: I shut the window and closed the curtains.
items.whyUz:
AND — qo'shimcha, o'xshash harakatlar.
DIQQAT: ikkinchi qismda ega ('I') TUShIB QOLDI —
bu 'and' ning belgisi.
4-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda 'then' va ega saqlangan.

items.textEn: 6  He screamed for help. + Nobody could hear him.
items.answer: He screamed for help, but nobody could hear him.
items.whyUz:
BUT — QARAMA-QARShILIK.
Qichqirdi ↔ lekin hech kim eshitmadi.
Oldidan VERGUL.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text and fill in and, but, so, because, or when.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing va and, but, so, because yoki when ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: and, but, so, because, when

DIQQAT: bu ro'yxatda 'THEN' YO'Q —
8-mashqning ro'yxatidan farq qiladi.

5 ta bog'lovchi, 10 ta bo'shliq — demak takrorlanadi:
  and     → 4 marta
  but     → 2 marta
  when    → 2 marta
  so      → 1 marta
  because → 1 marta

TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Lucy was in her bedroom WHEN the doorbell rang. It was
  dark, SO she switched on the lights AND went downstairs.
  She opened the front door, BUT there was nobody there.
  Nervously, she closed the door AND went into the
  living-room. She was very scared BECAUSE she was all
  alone. She closed the windows AND doors tightly. BUT, she
  heard a strange noise in the garden. She went to the
  window AND looked out nervously. She screamed WHEN she
  saw what was outside!


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  Lyusi yotoqxonasida edi, o'shanda eshik qo'ng'irog'i
  jiringladi. Qorong'i edi, shuning uchun u chiroqlarni
  yoqdi va pastga tushdi. Old eshikni ochdi, lekin u yerda
  hech kim yo'q edi. Asabiy holda eshikni yopdi va mehmon
  xonasiga kirdi. U juda qo'rqib ketdi, chunki uyda
  yolg'iz edi. Deraza va eshiklarni mahkam yopdi. Lekin
  bog'da g'alati shovqin eshitdi. Deraza oldiga bordi va
  asabiy holda tashqariga qaradi. Tashqarida nima borligini
  ko'rganida qichqirib yubordi!


DIQQAT — 8-BAND ALOHIDA HOLAT:
  Bo'shliq YANGI GAP boshida turibdi va undan keyin
  VERGUL qo'yilgan:
     '8) ............., she heard a strange noise'

  Ro'yxatdagi besh so'zdan gap boshida kela oladigan
  YAGONA so'z — 'BUT'.
  Ma'nosi ham mos: hamma joyni mahkam yopdi (xavfsiz
  deb o'yladi), LEKIN shovqin eshitdi.

  Rasmiy yozuvda 'But' dan keyin vergul qo'yilishi
  g'ayrioddiy, lekin kitobda shunday bosilgan.


BU HAM QO'RQINChLI HIKOYA:
  Grammar 49-betdagi Salli hikoyasiga juda o'xshash —
  ikkalasi ham yolg'iz qolgan qiz va g'alati shovqin
  haqida, ikkalasining ham oxiri ochiq qoldirilgan.

items.textEn: 1  Lucy was in her bedroom ............ the doorbell rang.
items.whyUz:
WHEN — VAQT.
Davom etayotgan holat (yotoqxonada edi) +
to'satdan bo'lgan voqea (qo'ng'iroq jiringladi).
8-mashqning 3-bandiga o'xshash.

items.textEn: 2  It was dark, ............ she switched on the lights ...
items.whyUz:
SO — NATIJA.
SABAB (qorong'i edi) → NATIJA (chiroq yoqdi).
Oldidan VERGUL bor.
'switch on' = yoqmoq (= turn on).

items.textEn: 3  ... ............ went downstairs.
items.hintUz: Ikki harakat ketma-ket, ega BIR XIL
items.whyUz:
AND — qo'shimcha.
DIQQAT: ikkinchi qismda ega ('she') TUShIB QOLGAN —
'she switched on the lights and (she) went downstairs'.
'downstairs' = pastga (zinadan).

items.textEn: 4  She opened the front door, ............ there was nobody there.
items.whyUz:
BUT — QARAMA-QARShILIK.
Eshikni ochdi (kimdir bor deb o'yladi) ↔
lekin hech kim yo'q edi.
Oldidan VERGUL bor.
'nobody' = hech kim.

items.textEn: 5  Nervously, she closed the door ............ went into the living-room.
items.whyUz:
AND — qo'shimcha.
Ega yana TUShIB QOLGAN.
'Nervously' — RAVISh, gap boshida.
'go INTO' — harakat predlogi.

items.textEn: 6  She was very scared ............ she was all alone.
items.whyUz:
BECAUSE — SABAB.
'she was all alone' — qo'rqishning sababi.
Ro'yxatdagi 'because' YAGONA marta shu yerda.
'all alone' = butunlay yolg'iz.
Grammar 49-betdagi Salli hikoyasida ham xuddi shu edi.

items.textEn: 7  She closed the windows ............ doors tightly.
items.whyUz:
AND — bu yerda ikki GAP emas, ikki OT birlashtiriladi:
'the windows AND doors'.
'tightly' — RAVISh (mahkam).
Coursebook 77-betda ham 'closed the car windows TIGHTLY'.

items.textEn: 8  ............ , she heard a strange noise in the garden.
items.hintUz: Yangi gap boshida — ro'yxatdagi qaysi so'z shu joyga to'g'ri keladi?
items.whyUz:
BUT — QARAMA-QARShILIK.
Hamma joyni mahkam yopdi (xavfsiz deb o'yladi) ↔
LEKIN shovqin eshitdi.

DIQQAT — BU BAND ALOHIDA:
Bo'shliq YANGI GAP boshida va undan keyin VERGUL bor.
Ro'yxatdagi besh so'zdan ('and, but, so, because, when')
gap boshida kela oladigan YAGONA so'z — 'BUT'.
('When,' / 'Because,' / 'And,' / 'So,' bu joyda
mantiqan mos kelmaydi.)

ESLATMA: rasmiy yozuvda 'But' dan keyin vergul qo'yilishi
g'ayrioddiy, lekin kitobda shunday bosilgan.
8-mashqda 'then' bor edi va u bu yerga juda mos kelardi —
lekin 9-mashqning ro'yxatida 'then' YO'Q.

items.textEn: 9  She went to the window ............ looked out nervously.
items.whyUz:
AND — qo'shimcha.
Ega TUShIB QOLGAN: 'she went ... and (she) looked out'.
'look out' = tashqariga qaramoq.
'nervously' — RAVISh.

items.textEn: 10  She screamed ............ she saw what was outside!
items.whyUz:
WHEN — VAQT.
Qichqirish QAChON sodir bo'ldi — ko'rganida.
1-band bilan bir xil naqsh.
Hikoya OChIQ tugaydi — tashqarida nima borligi aytilmaydi.
Bu — qo'rqinchli hikoya uslubi.

exercises.instructionEn: When who, which, what are the subject of the question, the verb is in the affirmative form. When who, which, what are the object of the question, the verb is in the interrogative form.
exercises.instructionUz: who, which, what savol so'zlari gapning EGASI bo'lsa, fe'l tasdiq shaklida bo'ladi. Ular TO'LDIRUVCHI bo'lsa, fe'l so'roq shaklida bo'ladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA — JUDA MUHIM:

  who, which, what savol so'zlari savolning EGASI bo'lsa,
  fe'l TASDIQ shaklida bo'ladi.

  who, which, what savolning TO'LDIRUVChISI bo'lsa,
  fe'l SO'ROQ shaklida bo'ladi.


BUNI SODDA QILIB TUShUNTIRAMIZ:

  EGA so'ralganda → 'DID' KERAK EMAS
     WHO wrote this book?
     (fe'l 'wrote' — TASDIQ shaklida)
     Javob: DICKENS wrote it.  (Dickens = EGA)

  TO'LDIRUVChI so'ralganda → 'DID' KERAK
     WHAT did you write?
     (fe'l 'write' — SO'ROQ shaklida, 'did' bilan)
     Javob: I wrote A LETTER.  (a letter = TO'LDIRUVChI)


QANDAY ANIQLASh — JAVOBGA QARANG:

  Javob gapning BOShIDA (harakatni bajaruvchi) bo'lsa
     → EGA → 'did' YO'Q

  Javob gapning OXIRIDA (harakat tushadigan narsa) bo'lsa
     → TO'LDIRUVChI → 'did' BOR


MISOLLAR JUFTLAB:

  WHO called you?         — TOM called me.     (ega)
  WHO did you call?       — I called TOM.      (to'ldiruvchi)

  WHAT happened?          — AN ACCIDENT happened.  (ega)
  WHAT did you see?       — I saw AN ACCIDENT.     (to'ldiruvchi)

  WHICH bus goes to town? — THE NUMBER 5 goes.  (ega)
  WHICH bus did you take? — I took THE NUMBER 5. (to'ldiruvchi)


ESLATMA:
  Grammar 50-betdagi 10-mashq va Workbook 40-betdagi
  6-mashq aynan shu qoidani mashq qildiradi.

points.en: When who, which, what are the subject of the question, the verb is in the affirmative form.
points.uz: who, which, what savolning egasi bo'lsa, fe'l tasdiq shaklida bo'ladi.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 1-QOIDA.
Ya'ni 'did' KERAK EMAS.
Misol: 'WHO WROTE this book?' — 'wrote' tasdiq shaklida.

points.en: When who, which, what are the object of the question, the verb is in the interrogative form.
points.uz: who, which, what savolning to'ldiruvchisi bo'lsa, fe'l so'roq shaklida bo'ladi.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 2-QOIDA.
Ya'ni 'did' KERAK.
Misol: 'WHAT DID you WRITE?' — 'did write' so'roq shaklida.

points.en: Who called you? — Tom called me. (subject)
points.uz: Senga kim qo'ng'iroq qildi? — Tom qo'ng'iroq qildi.
points.noteUz:
'who' = EGA (qo'ng'iroq qiluvchi) → 'did' YO'Q.
Javob gapning BOShIDA.

points.en: Who did you call? — I called Tom. (object)
points.uz: Sen kimga qo'ng'iroq qilding? — Tomga qo'ng'iroq qildim.
points.noteUz:
'who' = TO'LDIRUVChI (qo'ng'iroq qilinadigan) → 'did' BOR.
Javob gapning OXIRIDA.

'what' = EGA → 'did' YO'Q.
DIQQAT: 'What DID happen?' odatda ishlatilmaydi.

points.en: What did you see? — I saw an accident. (object)
points.uz: Sen nimani ko'rding? — Baxtsiz hodisani ko'rdim.
points.noteUz:
'what' = TO'LDIRUVChI → 'did' BOR.
Fe'l ASOSIY shaklda ('see', 'saw' EMAS).

groups.explanationUz: Mashqda to'rt juft ataylab birga berilgan.

items.base: hold the ball OVER his head

groups.ruleUz: 'HAVE' — ikki xil ma'no, ikki xil qoida

groups.explanationUz: Kun davom etyapti, lekin ichidagi harakatlar tugagan.

groups.ruleUz: OLTI BOG'LOVChI — 8-mashqda har biri BIR MARTA
groups.explanationUz: Har biriga aniq mantiqiy aloqa mos keladi.

in the bathroom when it rang
shut the window and closed curtains

patterns.formula: Ega + IS/ARE + fe'l-ING + UP / DOWN / OVER / UNDER / THROUGH / INTO / ALONG / TOWARDS + joy.
patterns.exampleEn: The thief is climbing through the window. The girl is skiing down the mountain.
patterns.exampleUz: O'g'ri derazadan tirmashib kiryapti. Qiz tog'dan pastga chang'i uchyapti.

patterns.formula: I'M HAVING a busy day. First I TOOK ... Then I WENT ... and now I'M COOKING ... .
patterns.exampleEn: I'm having a really busy day. First I took the dog to the vet. Then I went shopping and now I'm cooking dinner.
patterns.exampleUz: Juda band kunim bo'lyapti. Avval itni veterinarga olib bordim. Keyin xaridga bordim va hozir ovqat pishiryapman.
patterns.explanationUz:
Bir xatboshida ZAMON ALMAShADI:
kun davom etyapti (continuous) → ichidagi tugagan
harakatlar (past) → ayni dam (continuous).

patterns.exampleEn: It was dark, so she switched on the lights. She was very scared because she was all alone.
patterns.exampleUz: Qorong'i edi, shuning uchun chiroqlarni yoqdi. U juda qo'rqdi, chunki yolg'iz edi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'so' — SABAB + so + NATIJA;
'because' — NATIJA + because + SABAB.

patterns.formula: Ega + WAS + joy + WHEN + to'satdan bo'lgan voqea.
patterns.exampleEn: Lucy was in her bedroom when the doorbell rang.
patterns.exampleUz: Lyusi yotoqxonasida edi, o'shanda eshik qo'ng'irog'i jiringladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'when' — davom etayotgan holat va to'satdan bo'lgan
voqeani bog'laydi.

patterns.formula: WHO + O'TGAN fe'l?   ('did' YO'Q — EGA)   ↔   WHO/WHAT + DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?   ('did' BOR — TO'LDIRUVChI)
patterns.exampleEn: Who called you? — Tom called me. / Who did you call? — I called Tom.
patterns.exampleUz: Senga kim qo'ng'iroq qildi? — Tom. / Sen kimga qo'ng'iroq qilding? — Tomga.
patterns.explanationUz:
Betning oxiridagi qoida.
Javob gap BOShIDA bo'lsa — EGA;  OXIRIDA bo'lsa — TO'LDIRUVChI.

patterns.exampleEn: She switched on the lights and went downstairs. She went to the window and looked out nervously.
patterns.exampleUz: U chiroqlarni yoqdi va pastga tushdi. Deraza oldiga bordi va tashqariga qaradi.
patterns.explanationUz: Ega BIR XIL bo'lsa, ikkinchi qismda tushirib qoldiriladi.
